subjects.name: Management and Organizational Behaviour
subjects.syllabus: Covers management functions, leadership, motivation, organizational culture, and group behavior.

subjects.name: Managerial Economics
subjects.syllabus: Examines demand, production, pricing, cost analysis, and economic decision making for managers.

subjects.name: Financial Accounting and Analysis
subjects.syllabus: Introduces accounting principles, financial statements, ratio analysis, and business reporting.

subjects.name: Business Communication
subjects.syllabus: Develops written, verbal, and professional communication skills required in business settings.

subjects.name: Marketing Management
subjects.syllabus: Studies customer behavior, segmentation, branding, pricing, promotion, and strategic marketing.

subjects.name: Business Research Methods
subjects.syllabus: Focuses on research design, hypothesis testing, data collection, and interpretation for business decisions.

subjects.name: Financial Management
subjects.syllabus: Covers capital budgeting, working capital, financing, valuation, and investment decisions.

subjects.name: Human Resource Management
subjects.syllabus: Introduces recruitment, training, performance management, compensation, and employee relations.

subjects.name: Operations Management
subjects.syllabus: Examines process design, productivity, quality, supply chains, and operational planning.

subjects.name: Corporate Strategy
subjects.syllabus: Covers competitive analysis, strategic direction, strategy implementation, and growth considerations.

subjects.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
subjects.syllabus: Explores opportunity recognition, start-up planning, innovation management, and venture creation.

subjects.name: Business Analytics
subjects.syllabus: Introduces data-driven decision making, dashboards, forecasting, and data interpretation in business.

subjects.name: Consumer Behaviour
subjects.syllabus: Studies perception, motivation, buying behavior, segmentation, and strategic marketing decisions.

subjects.name: Summer Internship
subjects.syllabus: Applies management theory in a live organization setting with report and presentation requirements.

subjects.name: Strategic Management
subjects.syllabus: Focuses on competitive strategy, environmental analysis, and strategic implementation decisions.

subjects.name: Project Work and Viva Voce
subjects.syllabus: Students complete a supervised management or business project and defend it through viva voce.
